items.summary: Create a dedicated landing page (route '/') that serves as the public entry point to RevReel. The page should prominently feature a 'Join RevReel' call-to-action button that triggers Internet Identity login. Upon successful authentication, the user is redirected to the main app feed ('/feed'). If the user is already authenticated, automatically redirect them to '/feed' without showing the landing page.

Update the TanStack Router route configuration in App.tsx to register the new landing page as the root route '/' and move or adjust the existing default route so the feed is accessible at '/feed'. Ensure the Layout shell is only applied to authenticated app routes, not the landing page.

Design the landing page with a visually striking hero section that includes the RevReel logo/wordmark, a bold tagline describing the car culture video platform, and the 'Join RevReel' authentication button. Use the existing dark theme with neon accent colors, glassmorphism, and car-culture aesthetic consistent with the rest of the app (Barlow font, OKLCH color tokens from index.css).
